async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Navigate to the homepage by clicking the 'Epoch & Drift Benchmark' link in the banner to avoid ambiguity
    homepage_link = page.get_by_role("banner").get_by_role("link", name="Epoch & Drift Benchmark")
    await homepage_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 2: Search for the target post on the homepage
    # Look for a link with the title '40 of our most helpful AI tips from 2025'
    target_post_locator = page.get_by_role("link").filter(has_text="40 of our most helpful AI tips from 2025")
    if await target_post_locator.count() > 0:
        await target_post_locator.first.click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    else:
        # If not found as a link, search in articles
        article_locator = page.get_by_role("article").filter(has_text="40 of our most helpful AI tips from 2025")
        if await article_locator.count() > 0:
            # Click the first link inside the article to go to the post page
            link_in_article = article_locator.first.get_by_role("link")
            await link_in_article.first.click()
            await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
        else:
            # If still not found, return an error as the task might be impossible with current state
            return "Target post '40 of our most helpful AI tips from 2025' not found on the homepage."
    
    # Step 3: Now on the post page, use the submit_comment_on_page function to leave the comment
    # Get the current page URL and extract the relative path for page_url
    current_url = page.url
    from urllib.parse import urlparse
    parsed_url = urlparse(current_url)
    page_url = parsed_url.path + ("?" + parsed_url.query if parsed_url.query else "")
    
    # Call the knowledge base function
    result = await submit_comment_on_page(
        page=page,
        page_url=page_url,
        comment_text="Great article!",
        commenter_name="User",
        commenter_email="user@example.com",
        commenter_website="",
        save_details=True
    )
    return result
